item.tib: man ngag rin chen phreng ba
item.coloph: rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/ skal ldan khyod la gtad pa yi/ gcig rgyud gyis shig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya skal ldan skyes bu gcig la sprod/ dad ldan grogs po'i (pos) bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ger bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ dge bas bde chen rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
